feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: CIBC plans capital markets office in Abu Dhabi to expand Middle East presence
entry.summary: CIBC plans Middle East expansion with new capital markets presence in Abu Dhabi 24 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 24, 2026CIBC announced its intention to establish a permanent capital markets presence in the Middle East through ADGM in Abu Dhabi, subject to required regulatory approvals. The planned office would serve as its primary regional gateway, deepening relationships with sovereign wealth funds, family offices and institutional investors across the Gulf Cooperation Council region. Correction Nov 27, 2026: Publication date changed from Nov 25, 2026 to Nov 24, 2026

entry.title: Italian law firm BonelliErede opens Abu Dhabi office under ADGM licence
entry.summary: BonelliErede doubles its presence in the United Arab Emirates with the opening of an office in Abu Dhabi 24 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 24, 2026Italian law firm BonelliErede has opened an office in Abu Dhabi after securing a licence from ADGM, the international financial centre there. It complements the firm's Dubai office, opened in 2017, and doubles its presence in the UAE. From both offices, the firm will advise institutional investors, asset managers, investment funds and companies operating in the Gulf region.

entry.title: ADFW 2026 announces its largest partner-led programme, headlined by L’IMAD
entry.summary: ADFW 2026 Unveils Largest-Ever Partner-Driven Programme, Headlined by L’IMAD ADGM / FSRA · Nov 20, 2026 · ReportAbu Dhabi Finance Week (ADFW) 2026, the fifth edition hosted by ADGM, will take place from 7 to 10 December 2026. Organisers announced the largest partner-led programme to date, with L’IMAD as headline partner. Partners will run summits, forums and investor engagements covering asset management, fintech, digital assets, real estate and sustainable finance.

entry.title: ADGM RA Consults on Proposed Amendments to Cell Companies Framework
entry.summary: ADGM RA Publishes Consultation Paper on Proposed Amendments to Cell Companies Framework 17 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 17, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe ADGM Registration Authority has issued Consultation Paper No. 10 of 2026 seeking public feedback on proposed amendments to Part 36 of the Companies Regulations 2020 and new Cell Companies Rules 2026. The proposals aim to make the cell company framework more accessible and clear by moving operational and administrative provisions into standalone rules while retaining core legal rights and protections. The consultation closes on 10 December 2026.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about false and misleading claims by Nour Partners
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts the Public to False and Misleading Claims Made by Nour Partners ADGM / FSRA · Nov 20, 2026 · GuidanceThe ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) warns that claims on the website of Nour Partners may mislead investors into believing the entity is licensed to operate in ADGM. The FSRA states that only authorised firms may undertake Regulated Activities in ADGM. It advises the public to verify a firm's Financial Services Permission on the FSRA Public Register before dealing with it.

entry.title: Morrison Opens Abu Dhabi Office in ADGM to Expand Middle East Presence
entry.summary: Morrison announces Middle East expansion with new office in Abu Dhabi’s ADGM 19 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 19, 2026Global infrastructure investment manager Morrison has announced the opening of an office in Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) as part of its international growth strategy. Partner Vincent Gerritsen has relocated to Abu Dhabi to lead its Middle East activities. Morrison has received In-Principle Approval from the FSRA for a Category 4 licence, subject to conditions and final regulatory approval.

entry.title: ADGM RA Consults on Amendments to Employment and Work Permit Rules
entry.summary: ADGM RA Publishes Consultation Paper on Proposed Amendments to Employment Regulations and Work Permit Rules 16 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 16, 2026 · Draft / consultationThe ADGM Registration Authority has issued Consultation Paper No. 9 of 2026 seeking public feedback on proposed amendments to the Employment Regulations 2024 and related Non-Employee Work Permit and Fees Rules. The amendments aim to clarify employer obligations on work permits and employer-sponsored residency visas, and strengthen protections for wages and statutory rights. The consultation closes on 9 December 2026. Correction Nov 19, 2026: Publication date changed from Nov 17, 2026 to Nov 16, 2026

entry.title: FSRA proposes further integration of virtual assets into its regulatory framework
entry.summary: FSRA Proposes to Further Integrate Virtual Assets into its Regulatory Framework 13 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 13, 2026 · Draft / consultation · CryptoTopic evidence: 「incorporate Virtual Assets ("VAs") within the scope of the definitions of "Specified Investment" and "Financial Instrument" in the Financial Services and Markets Regulations」 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM has published Consultation Paper No. 8 of 2026. It seeks public comment on including virtual assets within the definitions of "Specified Investment" and "Financial Instrument" in the FSMR, with related changes to the FSMR and FSRA Rulebooks. The paper also covers several miscellaneous proposals, and the consultation closes on 15 January 2027.

entry.title: ADGM Warns of Unauthorised Use of Its Academy Name in Investment and Trading Schemes
entry.summary: ADGM Issues Alert Concerning Misuse of the ADGM Academy Name in Investment and Trading Activities 09 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 9, 2026 · GuidanceThe ADGM Registration Authority has issued an alert that third-party websites and individuals are using the ADGM Academy name, logo and branding without authorisation to offer investment opportunities and trading services. The ADGM Academy is not licensed to offer investment opportunities, provide trading services or collect funds from the public. The public is advised to independently verify any claimed association, especially where payments or personal or financial information are requested, and particularly where funds are sought to be transferred to bank accounts outside the UAE.

entry.title: FSRA warns public about suspected fraudulent scheme by Airo Capitals
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts the Public of Suspected Fraudulent Scheme by Airo Capitals 05 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 5, 2026 · EnforcementThe Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM warns the public about a suspected fraudulent scheme by Airo Capitals. The entity falsely claims association with ADGM and FSRA regulation. The FSRA advises investors to verify firms through its Public Register and the ADGM Registration Authority's Public Register before dealing with them.

entry.title: FSRA statement on the Binance security incident
entry.summary: FSRA Statement Regarding Security Incident Involving Binance 30 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 30, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「The FSRA is aware of the matter relating to Binance exchange on 30 October 2026, concerning a security incident involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets.」 The Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) of ADGM says it is aware of a security incident at the Binance exchange on 30 October 2026 involving unauthorised withdrawals of assets. The FSRA is working closely with Binance and monitoring the situation. Protecting client interests and supporting market integrity and orderly functioning are its key priorities.

entry.title: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël CEO
entry.summary: Arab Bank Switzerland opens Abu Dhabi office and names Valérie Noël Chief Executive Officer 05 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 5, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss Private Bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has announced the start of its operations in ADGM, the international financial centre of Abu Dhabi, follo」 Arab Bank Switzerland ME Ltd, the regional entity of Swiss private bank Arab Bank Switzerland, has started operations in ADGM after receiving a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA. The entity will advise institutions, corporates, fintechs, family offices and high net worth clients on accessing, holding, managing and passing on digital assets within ADGM's regulatory framework. Valérie Noël has been appointed Chief Executive Officer.

entry.title: ADGM publishes guidance on crypto mining as the region's first such guidance
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance 28 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「the Guidance treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA and not a regulated financial service」 The Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi Global Market (ADGM) has published its Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities in and from ADGM. Issued under section 23 of the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity overseen by the RA rather than a regulated financial service. The guidance applies a technology-neutral approach covering Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms.

entry.title: Animoca Brands gets ADGM regulator permission to manage collective investment funds
entry.summary: Animoca Brands secures Financial Services Permission from ADGM’s FSRA to Manage Collective Investment funds 02 Nov 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Nov 2, 2026 · Licensing · CryptoTopic evidence: 「Animoca Brands today announced that its subsidiary, Animoca Asset Management (AD) Limited (AAM), has received a Financial Services Permission (FSP) by the Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA」 Animoca Brands announced that its subsidiary, Animoca Asset Management (AD) Limited (AAM), received a Financial Services Permission from the FSRA of ADGM. The permission authorizes it to manage collective investment funds in or from ADGM. The company says the permission extends its institutional capabilities and supports its expansion in the Middle East.

entry.title: ADGM's Third Global Media Forum Presents Abu Dhabi's Growth to International Journalists
entry.summary: ADGM’s 3rd Global Media Forum Showcases Abu Dhabi’s Growth Story to International Media 26 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 26, 2026ADGM held its third Global Media Forum, bringing 33 journalists, including 13 from overseas, to Abu Dhabi from 20 to 22 October 2026. entry.title: VARA Circular on Good Practices for VASP Public Disclosures
entry.summary: Circular: Good practices for VASP’s public disclosures VARA · Oct 28, 2026 · Guidance · CryptoTopic evidence: 「This circular is provided by VARA for the benefit of licensed Virtual Asset Service Providers ("VASPs")」 The Virtual Assets Regulatory Authority (VARA) issued a circular describing good practice for licensed VASPs' public disclosures, based on a thematic review of their disclosure practices. It stresses treating disclosure as an ongoing compliance obligation and covers pricing methodology, order routing, virtual asset information, protection of client assets, and third-party accounts. The circular is illustrative only and does not replace or modify any applicable Regulations or Rulebooks. The archived text and attachments run to about 16,613 characters; the summary is based only on the first 12,000. Check the original. 2 later passages mentioning crypto assets were also used to judge the topic.

entry.title: ADGM regulator fines MCA Auditors and its audit principal USD 88,000 over audit failings
entry.summary: ADGM’s RA Imposes Financial Penalties of USD 88,000 Against MCA Auditors and its Registered Audit Principal for Audit Failings 23 Oct 2026 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 23, 2026 · EnforcementThe ADGM Registration Authority imposed financial penalties totalling USD 88,000 on MCA Auditors and Advisors LLP and its Audit Principal for deficiencies in an audit. The action followed an on-site inspection of the firm's audit quality. Deficiencies included risk assessment, fraud risk, group audit requirements, governance communications, and insufficient evidence in material areas.

entry.title: Pantheon opens Abu Dhabi office and names regional head for Middle East
entry.summary: Pantheon expands Middle East presence with new Abu Dhabi office and senior regional appointment ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026Private markets firm Pantheon has opened its first office in ADGM, Abu Dhabi, and appointed Firas Mallah as Managing Director and Head of Middle East. The firm says the office will deepen its relationships with clients across GCC countries. The new office brings Pantheon's global footprint to 13 locations.

entry.title: FSRA Warns Public About Suspected Fraud by E-Community
entry.summary: FSRA Alerts Public to Suspected Fraudulent Scheme by E-Community ADGM / FSRA · Sep 30, 2026 · EnforcementThe ADGM Financial Services Regulatory Authority (FSRA) warns the public about a suspected fraudulent scheme and false claims by E-Community, operating from e-community.co. The FSRA is concerned these claims could mislead investors into believing the entity is licensed to operate in ADGM. The FSRA advises checking its Public Register to verify any firm's Financial Services Permission before dealing with it.

entry.title: ADGM Registration Authority Publishes 2026-2027 Regulatory Priorities
entry.summary: ADGM’s Registration Authority Publishes Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027 ADGM / FSRA · Oct 1, 2026 · GuidanceThe Registration Authority of Abu Dhabi's ADGM has published its Regulatory Priorities for 2026-2027, setting out areas of monitoring, supervision and enforcement focus for the year ahead. The document lists ten priority areas, including filings, audit quality, consumer protection and AML/CFT compliance, along with key performance indicators. It aims to improve transparency and help stakeholders prepare for supervisory attention.
